description.zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符。
description.en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name of the IP whitelist template must meet the following requirements:

*   The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   The name must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.
*   The name must be 2 to 120 characters in length.
The ID of the IP whitelist template.
The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name test_123 --global-security-group-id g-zsldxfiwjmti0kcm0000 --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
